notes:
Summary:
- Mid-market SaaS (customer support/chat automation) evaluating Redwood starting with Hosted API; interested in Dedicated once throughput/latency and cost profile proven.

Discovery highlights:
- Primary workload: multi-turn chat/agent orchestration (tool calling, external API execution), fallback reranking for ambiguous queries, embeddings for retrieval.
- Latency SLOs: 95th <= 600ms for agent responses (streaming enabled for perceived latency), tail latency and cold-starts are key.
- Throughput: peak bursts from 150-300 concurrent agents during business hours.
- Cost sensitivity: mid-market budget, wants clear per-token/streaming pricing and predictable committed capacity numbers for Dedicated.
- Security: must pass vendor security questionnaire (SSO/SAML, SOC2 required), KMS for customer keys, EU data residency for select accounts.

POC plan (agreed):
- 2-week Hosted API POC: implement streaming responses + tool-calling flow (calendar/email APIs), measure 50k messages, capture latency percentiles and stream startup times.
- Eval harness: run prompt/evals (50 prompt sets) to compare quality vs current model; attach regression gating thresholds (no >3% drop in task success for primary flows).
- Run A/B (hosted): baseline model vs latency-optimized variant (quantized / lower-context) to measure quality vs latency tradeoffs.
- Canary plan for Dedicated: if POC meets SLOs and budget, pilot Dedicated on a single shard with canary rollout and automatic fallback to Hosted.

Notes from calls:
- 2026-02-14 demo w/ Jordan, Raya, product lead (Marta): liked streaming + tool calling demo. Quote: "Streaming makes convo feel instant - big UX win."
- 2026-01-28 discovery call: security team asked about audit logs + KMS integration.
- SE action items: provide sample SLO dashboard, sample prompt/eval packs, and recommended batching/quantization profiles for chat agents.

Technical requirements & acceptance criteria:
- Streaming + tool-calling functional in Hosted POC (demo via Fireflies transcript ff_20260214_4451).
- 95th percentile <= 600ms on agent reply end-to-end in 2-week POC for 90% of test scenarios.
- Prompt/eval regression gating: automated eval runs pre-deploy; block rollouts if task success drops >3% or hallucination rate increases above baseline.
- Canary/A-B rollouts supported: need SDK hooks for routing, metric tagging, and automatic fallback to hosted model variant.

Pricing / commercial:
- Asking for committed Dedicated pricing for 3-month pilot + overage terms.
- Sensitive to unit cost; will consider Optimize add-on to tune batching/quant profiles.

Open questions / blockers:
- Security questionnaire outstanding (sent 2026-02-20).
- Procurement wants a sample SLO SLA for Dedicated before commit.
- Need clarity on EU data residency for subset of customers (legal team).

Next steps (near-term):
- SE (Raya) to deliver POC checklist + sample eval sets by 2026-03-03.
- Jordan to schedule kickoff call w/ eng + security (target 2026-03-05).
- Pricing call with procurement once POC metrics available (forecast April).
